name: Apis India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1983, APIS India Ltd is in the honey processing business and manufacturing of other edible products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company provides specialized honey, which comprises ginger, lemon, tulsi, organic, honey with nuts, and honey with comb, etc. It has also forayed into Tea, Cookies and Preserves

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 49.9% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 3.31 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 10.8% over past five years.
